result.stdout:
WebBundler
Usage:
  webbundler build [--config <path>]
  webbundler validate [--config <path>]
  webbundler check [--config <path>]

Commands:
  build      Build bundles and write output files.
  validate   Validate configuration and bundle inputs without writing files.
  check      Validate configuration and resolve bundle inputs without writing files.

Options:
  -c, --config <path>  Path to bundleconfig.json.
  -h, --help           Show help.
